name: Herborn (Germany)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Herborn (a castle with a bishop and figures on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Herborn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Herborn arms — castle with figures on blue
